text: now working on: Resolving merge of origin/main into main (ticket booking vs Anthropic provider switch)

Booking feature merged to main: new endpoints GET /api/booking/locations|search, POST /api/bookings, GET /api/bookings[/{pnr}], POST /api/bookings/{pnr}/pay|cancel. New CORS header X-Contact-Email. New env var BOOKING_DB_PATH (optional; defaults to /tmp on Vercel, so bookings are per-instance/ephemeral). New files: booking_api.py, booking_models.py, services/booking_*.py, frontend TicketBooking.jsx. Dashboard.jsx got a Book Travel button next to Save/Share. 422 responses no longer echo submitted values. Took Shiv's Anthropic provider in config.py/llm_service.py.
now working on: Adding Origin field + world place suggestions (Trip Details, plan API, saved/shared trips, booking)

Origin field shipped: new optional 'origin' on POST /api/plan and /api/replan (echoed into itinerary.origin); new GET /api/places/suggest?q= (worldwide typeahead via Open-Meteo geocoding, no new env vars); /api/booking/search accepts geo: tokens for origin/destination. Frontend: PlaceInput.jsx, utils/api.js; savedTrips/sharedTrips docs gain origin + originValue. Dashboard.jsx touched (Trip Details field, Book Travel prefill).
now working on: Diagnosing Firebase config / login on Vercel

Firebase diagnosis (read-only probes): code config is fine, but travi-vibesprint has Authentication NOT initialized (CONFIGURATION_NOT_FOUND) and NO Firestore database (404). Needs console steps by the project owner: enable Google sign-in, add travi-ai.vercel.app to Authorized domains, create Firestore DB, deploy firestore.rules. Checklist + probe commands are in README; firebase.json/.firebaserc added.
